svg.title: Flowchart of unit 78: any one of four causes (excess doṣa accumulation; vyavāya and the like, as stated; other diseases; earlier action of mother and offspring) releases the fetus from its bond like a fruit from its stalk; it passes the garbhaśayyā (probably the womb), hangs among liver, spleen and intestines, and disturbs the koṣṭha.
